convention: Incoming R, relative phase L/R=exp(-2i h a^2), field on departure exp(-i h x), U(k)=diag(exp(-ik),exp(ik)) H. Each half uses the stream every tick; H, I, X are supplied controls. Initial base width comes from an even, alternating-sign direction-only herald. Flight clock excludes herald and loop; table reports loop time and excursion.
first_chart_diagnostic: At M=111 an initial tie assignment at k=0,pi made the curvature-mass diagnostic differ by 1.274700520692562e-7 between conjugates. All physical position summaries agreed. Both dispersion-chart boundaries are now shared equally and their total mass is reported for every case.
control_target: The prediction field is the single ideal ray if curvature sign equals sign(h_ref) at -pi/2. The last r=f=3 mistuning deliberately prepares its opposite.
controls: No loop leaves a single rail with both curvatures. Tagged loop retains orthogonal labels, so no rail coherence survives a tag-blind read. All initial base/coin modes are retained in physical route checks. Conditional FFT flights use no quantum trajectories or Monte Carlo samples.
